shortDescription: The U.S. national average price of diesel surpassed $6 a gallon for the first time ever on Thursday, according to price tracker GasBuddy."Every truck, every delivery, every package, every grocery run just got more expensive," GasBuddy analyst Patrick De Haan said on social media site X.
